notes.title: 🎄 DECEMBER HOLIDAY EVENT! 🐰
notes.content:
This December, embrace the magic of the season in Town Keeper! Our adorable rabbit town-building adventure is getting a festive makeover that will warm your heart faster than a cozy winter fireplace.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150629/865062322cefdffa922299dcc071da6744c155c3.png[/img]

Update now on Steam and conquer Town Keeper in ANY difficulty level to unlock two limited-edition holiday skins:
[list]
[*] Santa Villager Skin
[*] Worker Reindeer Skin
[/list]
⏰ [b]Time-Limited Event: December 2024[/b]🎮 
[h2]How to Participate:[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Ensure your game is updated via Steam
[*] Start a new game or continue your existing town
[*] Complete the game on ANY difficulty
[*] Automatically unlock your exclusive Christmas skins!
[/olist]
Don't miss this chance to dress your hardworking rabbit citizens in their most festive attire. Spread holiday cheer, build your dream town, and celebrate the season of giving!

notes.title: 🐰🎃Get limited Halloween skins today!🎃🐰
notes.content:
Attention all keepers! This October, we're bringing some spooky costume to your town! If you're up for it, you can [b]unlock these spooky skins for your villagers and workers by winning a game with any town on any difficulty during October.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150629/db20436cf8d1f8789fd34be93e1ca150a0780e1a.png[/img]

🐰👻 GHOSTLY VILLAGERS: Unlock a limited-edition skin of rabbits in adorable white ghost sheets
🐰🎃 PUMPKIN WORKERS: Get a special worker skin featuring rabbits with pumpkin heads and sickles

Just a heads up:
- Make sure you've got the latest version of the game, or it might not work (I learned that the hard way!)
- These skins are kinda like a secret surprise, so they won't show up in the menu until you've unlocked them.

[b]This hauntingly event hops away at midnight on October 31st! Don't miss your chance to add some boo-tiful charm to your Rabbit Town. Play now and claim rewards![/b]

Note: This patch also comes with handy QOL updates based on your feedback:
- Hit 'U' to upgrade a building you've selected
- Press 'X' if you want to demolish selected building
- New setting to show or hide building's production popup

We're always trying to make the game better, so there might be more stuff coming soon. I hope you'll stick around to see what we come up with!

notes.title: Save/Load Bug Fix
notes.content:
Important Changes

[list]
[*] Fixed a critical bug that caused the game to incorrectly save and load flags.
[*] Improved overall game performance.
[/list]
⚠️ WARNING ⚠️

After updating, you will not be able to continue playing towns from older versions. However,[b] all your unlocked progression, achievements, and time records will be preserved and protected. Even after future updates, your progress will remain intact and will not be reset.[/b]

Sorry for any inconvenience this may cause.

notes.title: Minor Patch - 21 Sep 2024
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash that was occurring across all game difficulty levels.
[*] Fixed an issue where some unlockables were incorrectly becoming available in lower difficulty levels.
[*] Corrected missing translations in various unlock condition descriptions.
[*] Added support for physical key input to accommodate multiple keyboard layouts.
[/list]

notes.title: Hot Fix Patch: Clash Issue
notes.content:
We've identified and addressed two distinct crash issues that some players have been experiencing. This hot fix aims to resolve these problems.

[b]Issue 1: Game Crashes on Startup[/b]
Problem: The game closes instantly after the Godot logo or crashes when opened for the first time.
Solution: Update your Steam client. Usually, restarting your computer and reopening Steam will trigger the update automatically.

[b]Issue 2: Crash After Intro[/b]
Problem: The game crashes after the "rabbits on the hill" intro.
Solution: This hot fix specifically addresses this issue. After updating the game, you should be able to play without encountering this crash. If you continue to experience issues after applying this update, please let us know in the community forums.

I apologize for any inconvenience these issues may have caused and appreciate your patience as we work to improve your gaming experience.

notes.title: Town Keeper is Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150629/a39df62ca700a5009f77f71e0b87dee625237acd.png[/img]

I'm bouncing with joy to announce the launch of Town Keeper on Steam! 

[b]Key Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Tile-based town building focused on maximizing resource yields
[*] Train an army of fluffy defenders to protect your town
[*] Manage town resources, upgrades, trade, and research
[*] Flexible difficulty options from cozy to intense gameplay
[*] 6 unique towns to unlock and play. New townhalls, perks, and rabbit characters to discover.
[*] Cute bunny!!! Oh yea!!!
[/list]

[b]Connection to Farm Keeper:[/b]
Town Keeper is set in the same universe as our previous game, Farm Keeper. It's a prequel that builds on the tile-based gameplay you loved. Get both games in a special bundle deal!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/45356/Keeper_Collection/]Keeper Collection Promotion Bundle[/url]

[b]Future Plans:[/b]
Stay tuned for updates, including new towns to explore.
Join us in Town Keeper and build your rabbit kingdom today!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3104510/Town_Keeper/]Get Town Keeper[/url]

notes.title: The Demo is Live!
notes.content:
It’s here! The first playable demo of Town Keeper!! I'm so excited even if I'm the only one who reads this announcement.

[b]What's in the burrow?[/b]
[list]
[*] Build your dream rabbit town with all the carrots and whistles!
[*] Research new technologies (No carrot-powered rockets, sorry)
[*] Trade your way to bunny prosperity
[*] Watch your furry soldiers in adorable auto-battles
[/list]

The game challenge is freely adjustable:
🥕 Peaceful Mode: For a relaxing burrow-building experience
🥕🥕 Normal Mode: A balanced challenge for everybunny
🥕🥕🥕 Challenge Mode: For real strategists who yearn for an intense challenge!

We hope you have a hopping good time!

P.S. No real rabbits were pixelated in the making of this game. 😉🐰
